title: Reparo: Synthesizing and Validating Access Control Policies
title_zh: Reparo：访问控制策略的合成与验证

paragraphs.en: Reparo利用LLM和仓库证据实现访问控制策略的合成、修复与验证，策略有效率高达99%以上。 Writing correct access control policies for software applications is difficult because it requires expertise in the authorization language and a thorough understanding of the application's authorization requirements. Existing synthesis and mining approaches assume explicit authorization inputs and a trusted reference policy. However, authorization logic is often distributed across code, comments, and documentation rather than captured in a single artifact, and developer-defined policies in real-world application repositories are often incomplete, outdated, or incorrect. We present Reparo, an LLM-aided pipeline for access control policy synthesis, repair, and validation. Reparo collects repository evidence for authorization intent and uses it to guide an LLM in generating an initial policy. It then uses official policy-language validation tools to identify and automatically repair errors. For semantic validation, a different LLM derives a behavioral oracle from the same repository evidence, consisting of concrete authorization requests with expected allow or deny decisions, which Reparo executes against the generated policy. We manually assess the oracle on a statistically sized sample of 390 test cases. We evaluate Reparo on 228 real-world GitHub repositories that use Cedar, OpenFGA, or Rego. In these repositories, 40.6-55.7% of the repository policies fail their language's validation tool, whereas Reparo produces 99.0-100% valid policies after repair. Agreement with the oracle is 98.2-99.6% for OpenFGA, 82.0-86.5% for Cedar, and 76.3-80.2% for Rego. Manual review confirms 91.5-96.9% of the sampled test cases as correct. Synthesizing and validating the policy for one repository takes about five minutes and costs $0.55-$1.57. These results show that repository evidence can support both access policy synthesis and independent validation, even when no reliable reference policy exists.
paragraphs.zh: Reparo 利用 LLM 和仓库证据实现访问控制策略的合成、修复与验证，策略有效率高达 99% 以上。为软件应用编写正确的访问控制策略很困难，因为这既需要熟悉授权语言，又需要深入理解应用的授权需求。 现有的合成与挖掘方法假设存在显式的授权输入和一个可信的参考策略。 然而，授权逻辑往往分散在代码、注释和文档中，而不是记录在单一制品中，并且真实应用仓库中开发者定义的策略往往不完整、过时或不正确。 我们提出了 Reparo，一个借助 LLM 的访问控制策略合成、修复与验证流水线。 Reparo 收集仓库中有关授权意图的证据，并利用这些证据引导 LLM 生成初始策略。 随后，它使用官方的策略语言验证工具来识别并自动修复错误。 在语义验证方面，另一个 LLM 从同一仓库证据中推导出一个行为预言（oracle），其中包含带有预期允许或拒绝决策的具体授权请求，Reparo 针对生成的策略执行这些请求。 我们在 390 个测试用例的统计样本上对预言进行了人工评估。 我们在使用 Cedar、OpenFGA 或 Rego 的 228 个真实 GitHub 仓库上评估了 Reparo。 在这些仓库中，40.6%–55.7% 的仓库策略无法通过其语言的验证工具，而 Reparo 在修复后能够生成 99.0%–100% 的有效策略。 与预言的一致率在 OpenFGA 上为 98.2%–99.6%，在 Cedar 上为 82.0%–86.5%，在 Rego 上为 76.3%–80.2%。 人工审查确认抽样测试用例中有 91.5%–96.9% 是正确的。 为一个仓库合成并验证策略大约需要五分钟，成本为 0.55 至 1.57 美元。 这些结果表明，即使不存在可靠的参考策略，仓库证据也能同时支持访问策略的合成与独立验证。
